verdict.rationale: Ironclad has a first-party 'Ironclad AI' product page titled 'A New Era of Contract Intelligence', which points to in-product AI over contract data, but the evidence does not describe what insights or suggestions it actually produces. The Workflow API guide on running your own AI-driven analysis is a developer building block, not a native capability, so it earns no credit. Missing for 10: any description of the in-product AI insights or suggestions, how they draw on the user's contract data, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
